descriptor.retrieval_description: Woven leather monkey fist knot object. The intended contact region is dry, highly irregular with interwoven strands, ridges, and varying curvature, presenting a complex textured surface.
descriptor.contact_region: Lateral opposing exterior surfaces of the woven leather knot where the grip pads would engage the intertwined strands.
descriptor.visible_surface_condition: Dry, clean, and textured with natural leather grain.
descriptor.local_geometry: Highly irregular and complex due to interwoven braided leather strands creating multiple ridges, gaps, and varying curvature.
descriptor.contact_patch_visibility: Clearly visible on the exterior portions of the knot.
descriptor.uncertainty: Exact points of contact depend heavily on the precise orientation of the gripper relative to the complex interlaced strands of the knot.
